purpose: Extend the already fixed four information settings to all available captured 2026 official lineups without retuning.
cohort_rule: All source-validated fixture/team/both starting nines and unique schedule-listed pitcher identities. Never select by model score, realized result or ROI.
history_rule: Calendar dates strictly before target; retain missing and stale-history diagnostics, never backfill with target statistics.
required_diagnostics: latest prior-history date and gap distributions
identical common prices and refund denominator
limitations: 2026 is retrospective and previously inspected, including partial official-batting results.
Current official records do not establish pregame publication, historical receipt or exact executable price.
This isolates source information under fixed models rather than training an optimal official-lineup model.
